intro.summary: Third-year Information Technology student at KMUTT and part-time Software Engineer Intern at Agoda, working on a Kotlin/Ktor service template and its end-to-end development workflow. Previously built a C#/.NET OTA integration and an AI-assisted grading MVP at SIT.

projects.name: MMORPG Shop
details: Built an MMORPG item-shop backend with auth, player, item, inventory, and payment domains.
Applied DDD to split business domains and Clean Architecture with handler, use-case, and repository layers.
Implemented event-driven buy/sell workflows with compensating rollback when a transaction step fails.
Built protected service APIs with persistent data storage and role-based access control.

Monitored an A/B rollout, quickly diagnosing and resolving issues to maintain a smooth user experience.
